description: This file contains shell script code for upgrading platform firmware on a device. It defines functions for checking the firmware image and performing an upgrade, with custom logic based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function that checks the image; always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Function to perform the upgrade; uses the board name to decide whether to call default upgrade process.
